question.text: Two discs of moment of inertia <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>I</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>I</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> about their central axes & normal to their planes, rotating with angular speeds <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mi>rad</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mo>&</mo><mo> </mo><mn>4</mn><mo> </mo><mi>rad</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> respectively are brought into contact face to face with their axe of rotation coincident. The loss in kinetic energy of the system in the process is _________<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">J</mi></math>.

solution.text:
Applying conservation of angular momentum, we get

I1ω1+I2ω2=I1+I2ω0⇒4×10+2×4=4+2ω0⇒ω0=8 rad s-1

Now, initial rotational kinetic energy is E1=12I1ω12+12I2ω22=216 J

and final rotational kinetic energy is

E2=12I1+I2ω02=192 J

Required, energy loss ΔE=E1-E2=24 J
